# CodeRabbit repair-loop pilot — 2026-11-02

The [existing-code audit](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/1) submitted
61 files from source snapshot `007a47e53d833308d6b4e49d45e8bc5502ff93fa`.
CodeRabbit completed that review and published 76 original inline comments.
These are candidate findings, not 76 independently confirmed defects.
The artificial audit branches must never be merged.

## Confirmed repairs

| Finding | Reproduction before fix | Result after fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Unauthenticated config token bootstrap](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/1#discussion_r4440261637) | 11 of 12 focused cases failed: forged Host, hostile Origin and malformed headers reached the exemption. | All 12 pass; require loopback socket plus local Host and absent/local HTTP(S) Origin. Explicit bearer authentication and local development remain supported. |
| [Inference-session token exposed in settings](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/1#discussion_r4440269721) | 1 of 3 cases failed: metadata contained the synthetic credential. | All 3 pass; secret classification hides metadata values, locks settings writes and resolves only from the environment. Historical tokens already on disk are not automatically purged. |
| [Empty streamed arguments treated as complete](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/1#discussion_r4440261537) | 1 of 2 cases failed: a header-only call was eligible for eager dispatch. | Both pass; incomplete calls wait for JSON arguments, while explicit `{}` still completes. |

Each repair passed on its first check using exactly the test file recorded at
reproduction. The agent inspected the source and failing assertion before
changing production code. No bot suggestion was applied automatically.

The [setup PR's interrupt-cleanup finding](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/2#discussion_r4440269035)
also reproduced: the CLI failed to stop a hanging test promptly. After adding
SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup, all 8 runner tests pass, including process cleanup and
lock removal. Windows exercises the JS signal path through IPC; Linux CI sends
a real SIGTERM. The [PR-number example](https://github.com/traidy2222/liminal-ai/pull/2#discussion_r4440269028)
was corrected to a placeholder; a live `start --pr 2` imported PR 2's findings.

## Validation

- Full community build and all workspace type checks passed.
- Core suite: 550 tests passed, zero failures/skips.
- Focused audit regressions: 17 tests passed; an additional real HTTP middleware
  smoke test passed (18 total). Host spoofing and external Origin return 401;
  local bootstrap and explicit valid bearer access return 200.
- Review-loop suite: 8 tests passed, including real subprocess red/green runs,
  interruption, timeout, stale snapshots and exhausted retry budgets.
- Repository secret scan, typed-default secret check and diff whitespace check passed.
- CI runs both the loop suite and the confirmed audit regressions on every PR.

The three original findings are locally verified; **73 original audit comments
remain untriaged**. This pilot is not a complete repository security audit.
The normal fix PR still requires independent review and passing CI; nothing has
been auto-approved, auto-resolved, merged or deployed.

Local evidence is under `.agent_artifacts/review-loop/` in the isolated pilot
worktree: run `1793608322270-6465d19e` for the audit and
`1793608608627-bbff4525` for the setup review. It contains exact imported text,
source fingerprints and TAP output. Individual fingerprints describe the source
at each check; subsequent edits/commits mark those old checks stale. The final
combined regression suite and PR CI cover the assembled patch.

The loop is driven by the active coding session. It does not create a hosted
unattended fixer or start additional model/API spending. Its limits are three
repair checks and 30 minutes per finding, with five minutes per test process.
